scope: Five deterministic isolated effective-event arms, all completed before analysis. No full network, graph event/claw mapping, APL, recurrent assay, motor tuning or default promotion.
already_seen: Source summary means and analytic preview 3.57559ms candidate rise have already been inspected. This is a prospective computational check, not blind validation.
source: Turner et al. 2008 Fig3, female cohorts, not paired EPSP/EPSC cells; reported dispersion is not a confidence interval or hard cell bound.
equation: q=exp(-t/td)-exp(-t/tr); du/dt=(A*q-u)/tm. tr=0 denotes q=exp(-t/td). u is baseline-subtracted mV, A is effective equilibrium-voltage gain, not pA/nS/contact.

identification.epsc: td=2.8 under asymptotic interpretation; Brent tr in [0.001,2.799] to match 10-90 rise0.9.
identification.epsc_decay_anchored: tm=11.5 under asymptotic interpretation; predict EPSP rise.
identification.epsc_rise_anchored: Same EPSC; Brent tm in [0.05,11.5] to match EPSP rise2.1; predict late decay.
identification.intrinsic_boundary: Same EPSC; tm=200 is the lower boundary diagnostic, not an estimate or strict-bound pass.
identification.amplitude: Each non-contact arm has continuous peak1.4mV by one linear gain. Control amplitude-only changes p0 but leaves tm20/td5/tr0.
identification.current_contact: Native float32(0.275) nominal single-contact weight, not the measured spontaneous event.

recording.event: State initialized just after one accepted postsynaptic event at t=0. No presynaptic train, delay queue or release model is inferred.
recording.current_control: Unchanged LIFNetwork zero-edge 6-cell fixture: zero/contact/scaled event at native -52mV and held -58mV using constant current_mv=-6. Native thresholds/refractory retained; require no spikes/RNG changes.
recording.h1_control: Actual hybrid_step with h=0, native rest, same three initial p values at dt0.1; compare native LIF samples. H1 inhibition is not exercised.
recording.candidates: Exact matrix-exponential transitions, separate subthreshold testbed, no threshold/reset selection.
recording.clamp: Normalized input-current proxy only. At fixed -60mV baseline, q/peak(q) represents inward current magnitude without pA calibration; no current feedback into clamped voltage.
recording.intrinsic: Normalized -1mV asymptotic DC response and relaxation. No pA scale, no inferred Rin or capacitance.

metrics.primary: Continuous baseline-to-peak and 10-90 rising crossings; asymptotic late poles are conditional decay summaries.
metrics.secondary: Falling80-20 and50-10 equivalent exponential constants; descriptive, not a reproduction of unspecified source fitting windows.
metrics.sampling: Save all traces at each dt, compute sampled peak and interpolated rise, compare common times; exact integrators need not have monotonic roundoff.

conclusion_rule: Numerical validity is separate from conditional central-summary compatibility. No pass/fail biological tolerance from unspecified dispersion; retain signed mean residuals and strict intrinsic failure. Threshold, Rin, capacitance and contact gain unidentified.
held_out: Gruntman 2013 amplitudes and multi-claw responses excluded from parameter identification; already inspected, not blind. No new stochastic seed claim.
failure_policy: Do not overwrite frozen artifacts. Retain failures and any subsequent correction separately. No automatic parameter installation.
